Turkey Trot at The Bogs

November 22, 2026
9:00 AM - 10:00 AM
The Bogs
141 Acushnet Rd.
Mattapoisett, MA 02739
View on Google Maps

Looking for a fun way to get moving before Thanksgiving? 

Join Buzzards Bay Coalition for a Turkey Trot at The Bogs! Choose between two distances through the open wetlands: a 3/4-mile loop on flat terrain or a 1.5-mile loop featuring a stone ford to walk or hop across. Both routes offer views across the wetlands, with runners visible from the starting line throughout the event.

After your trot, enjoy a cup of cider and a small muffin. Every participant will also receive a raffle ticket for a chance to win some Buzzards Bay swag!

Come enjoy some fresh air, a little exercise, and a fun start to Thanksgiving week!

This is a FREE Bay Adventure. Register today to join the fun!

For more information, Email: Baptista@savebuzzardsbay.org
